name: Wesizwe Platinum Limited
source: Wesizwe Platinum Limited audited consolidated annual financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (https://wesizwe.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/wesizwe_afs_december-2025.pdf), consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, page 19, printed in R thousand. The group is a mine development entity: Revenue is nil in 2025 and 2024 and the statement presents no cost of sales line, so Cost of Sales and Gross Profit are not reported and are left empty. Administration expenses 162 152 (2024 restated 94 583); net operating costs (180 004) and (266 276); finance income 956 090 and 18 799 less finance expense 591 247 and 6 994; profit before taxation 184 839 and (254 471); income tax 25 236 and a credit of 55 366; profit for the year 159 603 and (199 105). Restated 2024 comparatives per note 36. Prior years 2023 and 2022 are not re-sourced here, so their operating lines are withheld rather than carried from an unreconciled feed. | CRON 20261111: FY2024 Revenue set to 0 from the audited consolidated statement of profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 2025 (Wesizwe Platinum Limited annual financial statements 2025, page 19), whose restated 2024 comparative column prints Revenue as nil for the Group; the directors' report states the Group remains under development and has not yet generated revenue from mining operations. The file already carried 0 for the other annual columns. | CRON 20261111: FY2024 Net Finance Costs sign corrected to the positive net finance income the audited statement prints (finance income 18,799 less finance expense 6,994 equals 11,805); operating result (266,276) plus 11,805 equals the printed loss before taxation (254,471).
